caseName: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. v. Haeger
caseNameFull: The GOODYEAR TIRE & RUBBER COMPANY v. Leroy HAEGER

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted limited to Question 1 presented by each petition. The case is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
